ADAPTATION / DOCUMENTED UNSUPPORTED-FEATURE CHANGES (removal/substitution list):
(1) TIMING AND REALS DROPPED (declared): the Pascal clock/timer loop
(MicrosecondsPerRun, runs-with-no-multiplication measurement, the real
divisions and the 'too small to time' branch) is unreproducible in a
deterministic complete-stream harness and is removed; the printed stream is
the banner, the prompt+echo, 'Execution starts,' and the final-values table.
(2) RUN COUNT INPUT: readln(NumberOfRuns) becomes ONE numeric GET
get list(numruns); console_input is 7-CRLF-then-^Z (N=7). MEASURED echo law:
the echoed value line KEEPS its trailing CR (expected line 5 is '7\r').
(3) RECORD/POINTER MODEL: the two RecRecord pointer slots and their variant
fields (Discr/IntComp/EnumComp/StringComp) become parallel AUTO arrays -
pcp/dsc/enm/inc(2) plus sx(180) holding six 30-cell string positions (bases
0/30/60/90/120/150 in the model, 1-based PL/I cells 1/31/61/91/121/151);
PointerGlob is a slot index; whole-record assignment becomes the cp30 copy
loop; the variant dereference ^ becomes index temps. STATIC arrays are a
measured my-compiler refusal (codegen [TBD], [C159/AB5]) so ALL array state
is outer AUTO, and EXPLICIT zero-init loops are required - the initial
content of an un-initialized static DATA segment is UNMEASURED on lane B.
(4) STRINGS: the 30-char packed FixedString values are positional
character-code cells; StringComp/1st/2nd/3rd rows print via the nested
putstr(base) printer, which SKIPS blank (code-32) tail cells - measured
in-flight that blank items push the label+30-token raw line to 84 bytes,
CROSSING the 79-column PLILIB wrap measured (lane-B witness) to fire at
exactly 79 columns (the wrap law itself stays PROPOSED, NOT a DR claim).
(5) ENUM/BOOL/CHAR: Enumeration values are 0/1/2 codes printed as numbers;
BoolGlob prints the literal TRUE via if boolg = 1 then put list('TRUE');
Char1/2Glob (65/66) print through the code->character putc ladder.
(6) VAR PARAMETERS: PROC.CALL_COPYIN has no by-reference convention - every
var-param call (proc1/2/3/6/7/8, divsub) writes a RESULT CELL (r2, r3, r6,
r7, dvq) and the caller assigns it back; this is the measured calling model.
(7) DIVISION: the ONE variable-divisor div becomes the divsub subtraction
loop: DIV by non-constant is a recorded my-gap COMPILE FAIL on my compiler
(HAMM-00 rev1 witness); DR's behaviour is UNMEASURED - neither is a DR claim.
(8) REFUSED FORMS REWRITTEN (all measured on my compiler, scratch): do until
REFUSED in both spellings -> label + flag-goto loops; if a > 0 REFUSED
(compare > k<=0 form unproven) -> the proc3 nil-test became the domain
ladder r3 = 0; if t3a = 1 then r3 = 1; if t3a = 2 then r3 = 2 (pcp is in
{0,1,2}, exactly equivalent); a call inside a condition REFUSED -> hoisted
to a scalar (tv = f2(60, 90); if tv = 0 then boolg = 1;); DO WHILE admits
only the < form -> flat <= label loops; <> -> branch swap with =; and/or ->
nested ifs; case -> if ladder; with -> index temp.
(9) NUMERIC-LITERAL PUT GAP: put list(<numeric literal>) is a measured
my-gap refusal (PUT form not in E2E-3a subset) - every should-be constant
prints as a CHARACTER literal (identical under collapse-spaces-v1); the
Array2Glob should-be row prints the scalar via %9d (port raw 1368 B vs sim
1361 B - the ONLY difference, identical after normalization).
(10) TP00 LAW (measured lane-B witness, my-gap class, NOT a DR claim): a
nested-procedure array store whose subscript is the FORMAL ITSELF is
SILENTLY LOST - every formal is copied to a local BEFORE any subscript; the
pin obeys this in all 14 nested subroutines.
(11) LAYOUT LAW (measured): ALL main-body statements precede ALL nested
definitions (otherwise codegen: call-site queue mismatch); the 14 nested
subroutines (proc5 proc4 proc7 proc8 proc1 proc3 proc6 proc2 f1 f2 f3
divsub cp30 putc putstr) follow stop;.
(12) APOSTROPHES: Pascal literals contain apostrophes; no apostrophe may
appear inside a literal in this corpus - 1ST/2ND/3ND-free spellings declared
(this port uses 1ST/2ND; the 3RD string is internal only).
(13) TABLE FRAMING (declared cosmetic adaptation): each final-value row
prints label line / value or string line / should-be line (three lines),
where Pascal used one write-ln per row; the string rows print the 30 tokens
space-separated by the MEASURED single-item PUT separator law.
(14) DERIVATION: expected.console is GENERATED from reference.py:dhry00, a
statement-for-statement mirror of THIS pinned source, and was diffed
BYTE-EQUAL against the independent simulator
build/fc01-scratch/dhry00/dhry00_sim.py check(7) (itself cross-checked
against dhry00_pascal_sim.py, the line-for-line Pascal model) on all 57
normalized lines BEFORE this JSON was written; the generating script
re-runs that byte-equality and aborts on any mismatch. Invariants asserted
on EVERY derivation run: the 20/20 published Dhrystone should-be column at
N=7 (IntGlob 5, Bool TRUE, A, B, a1(8) 7, a2(8,7) 17, slot1 0/2/17/
SOME-STRING, slot2 0/1/18/SOME-STRING, 5/13/7, EnumGlob 1, sg1 '1', sg2
'2'), the port FINAL STATE, exactly ONE GET, the <=78-column frame law for
every emitted segment, and the 57-line / 1368-port-raw-byte identity.
Never captured (L3).
(15) CAPABILITIES were grep-verified twice by this script: each id exists in
spec/COVERAGE.tsv with dr_status=ACCEPTS and mine_status=SUPPORTED AND its
construct appears in DHRY-00.PLI with comments stripped; the script also

(16) FRAMING [C352]: the stream starts with ONE blank line (first PUT SKIP)
and ends with two PUT SKIP lines plus the exit CRLF - 57 normalized lines;

(17) Lane-B RUN of THIS program - the full 14-subroutine call graph, the
